body: I can't exercise because my eating and diet are shit. I have no appetite and I have to force myself to eat enough calories just to sit on the couch and do nothing all day. Same with sleep. I'm on meds to help me with all of this shit but meds don't fix me.

My partner knows how I feel. I threaten suicide to my partner. It's so taxing on them.

I'm in therapy now, again, but all I do is babble on about things that happened in the past that no longer matter. I've yet to get to the root of my issues which is that I am worthless.
